card.name: See-reference after bracketed label statements
card.fires_on: The word "see" (or the opening bracket just before it) that begins a cross-reference like [see Adverse Reactions (6.1)] at the end of a sentence in a drug label's highlights or patient-counseling text.

modes.label: See after open bracket
modes.description: The word "see" right after "[" that introduces a section cross-reference at the end of a sentence.
modes.example: Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with ALECENSA and for 5 weeks following the last dose [<<see>> Use in Specific Populations (8.

modes.label: Open bracket itself
modes.description: The bracket just before "see" when the cross-reference begins.
